SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I, Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date. September 18, 40.
（印：MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY File No. 387）

Subject Threatening letter received by D.I. Kao Yen-ken

Made by D.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by D.S.I. Logan

Forwarded herewith is a threatening letter
dated September 15th, addressed to D.I. KAO YEN-
KEN, which purports to emanate from the body of
workers of the Shanghai Tramways. It was
received through the post at Police Headquarters
on September 17.

It is believed that the missive is the work
of some individual who might have some grievance
towards D.I. Kao and who has sent this letter under
the assumed name of the body of workers of the
Shanghai Tramways.

At all events, D.I. Kao Yen-ken has no reason
to suppose that the letter in question originated
from the workers of the Shanghai Tramways.

（批：19/9 17 G.）

Kao Yen-Ken
D. I.

D.C. (Special Branch)

报告
日期：1940年9月18日。
（印：公共租界警务处登记处 档案号 387）

事由：督察高延根收到恐吓信

由督察高延根制作，经副督察长洛根转呈

现随文转呈一封日期为9月15日、致督察高延根的恐吓信，该信声称发自上海电车工人团体。此信于9月17日通过邮政寄至警务处总部。

据信，此函系某个人所为，此人可能对高督察怀有不满，并假借上海电车工人团体之名寄出此信。

无论如何，高延根督察没有理由认为该信出自上海电车工人之手。

（批注：9月19日 17 G.）

高延根
督察

特别分部副主任

page_data.en:
Translation of a threatening letter addressed
to D.I. Kao Yen-ken (Special Branch) pur-
porting to emanate from the body of workers
of the Shanghai Tramways

Mr. Kao Yen-ken:

We understand that you have assumed
the responsibility for the payment of our wages.
We will see whether your precious body can stand
the penetration of bullets.

We have nothing more to add in this
letter.

The body of workers of
the Shanghai Tramways.

Dated September 15th.
page_data.zh:
致督察高延根（特别分部）的恐吓信译文，
该信声称发自上海电车工人团体

高延根先生：

据悉，你已承担起支付我们工资的责任。
我们要看看你那宝贵的身体能否抵挡子弹的穿透。

此信再无赘言。

上海电车工人团体

日期：9月15日
